title: Santander Enters AI Business, Stock Prices Reach Historical Highs
description: Banco Santander's stock prices are reaching historical highs following the bank's entry into the AI business and a significant purchase.

sources.title: ¿Qué pasa con las acciones de Santander? El banco entra en el negocio de la IA
Acciones de Banco Santander desafían máximos históricos: ¿puede superar los 13€ tras la compra de Webster?
Santander coordinará un crédito de 22.800 millones para centros de datos de Oracle y OpenAI

sections.heading: Santander's AI Business
paragraphs: According to XTB.com, Banco Santander is entering the AI business, which could be a significant factor in the recent surge of its stock prices.

sections.heading: Historical Highs in Stock Prices
paragraphs: Benzinga España reports that Banco Santander's stock prices are challenging historical maximums, with a potential to surpass 13€ following the acquisition of Webster.

sections.heading: Santander's Major Credit Coordination
paragraphs: El Economista states that Santander is coordinating a credit of 22.800 million euros for data centers of Oracle and OpenAI, indicating a significant move in the tech industry.

faq.q: Why are Santander's stock prices increasing?
faq.a: According to XTB.com, the increase is related to Santander's entry into the AI business.

faq.q: What is Santander's recent significant purchase?
faq.a: As reported by Benzinga España, Santander's recent significant purchase is Webster, which could contribute to the stock price increase.

faq.q: What is Santander's role in the tech industry?
faq.a: El Economista reports that Santander is coordinating a substantial credit for Oracle and OpenAI's data centers, highlighting its involvement in the tech sector.
